description: Complete the Traveler Community Platform by adding missing UI components and backend features. Backend routes and models (Post, Comment, ForumTopic, ModerationLog) exist at frontend/server/routes/community.js with 11 endpoints. Frontend has CommunityService and partial components. Add post creation form, edit/delete own posts UI, image upload capability, and improve feed with category filters and search.
steps: 1. Read existing backend files: frontend/server/controller/community.js, frontend/server/models/post.js, frontend/server/models/comment.js, frontend/server/models/forumTopic.js, frontend/server/middleware/verifiedGuard.js to understand current implementation
2. Read existing frontend files: frontend/src/app/Component/community/ (all 4 sub-components), frontend/src/app/service/community.service.ts to understand current UI
3. Add missing controller methods in frontend/server/controller/community.js: updatePost (allow author to edit within 24h), deletePost (author only, soft delete by setting hidden=true)
4. Add corresponding routes in frontend/server/routes/community.js: PUT /api/v1/community/posts/:id (author only), DELETE /api/v1/community/posts/:id (author only)
5. Add image URL field to Post model in frontend/server/models/post.js: imageUrl: { type: String, optional: true }
6. Update frontend/src/app/service/community.service.ts: add updatePost(postId, payload), deletePost(postId) methods

7. Create post creation form component at frontend/src/app/Component/community/post-form/post-form.component.ts with title input, body textarea, tags multi-select, optional image URL input, submit button. Use TranslateModule and COMMUNITY.* translation keys

8. Add edit and delete buttons to frontend/src/app/Component/community/post-card/post-card.component.ts. Show edit/delete only if currentUser.googleId === post.authorId. Edit opens inline form, delete shows confirmation dialog

9. Add category filter dropdown and search input to frontend/src/app/Component/community/community-feed/community-feed.component.ts. Filter by tags on frontend, search filters post.title and post.body locally

10. Update frontend/src/assets/i18n/en.json, hi.json with new keys: COMMUNITY.POST_IMAGE, COMMUNITY.EDIT_POST, COMMUNITY.DELETE_POST, COMMUNITY.DELETE_CONFIRM, COMMUNITY.FILTER_BY_TAG, COMMUNITY.SEARCH_POSTS. Add mr.json (Marathi) by copying en.json structure with placeholder English text
11. Ensure verifiedGuard middleware is applied to POST /api/v1/community/posts and PUT /api/v1/community/posts/:id (already applied to POST, verify and add to PUT)
12. Add authorization checks in updatePost and deletePost controllers: extract authorId from post, compare with req.headers['x-user-id'], return 403 if mismatch
acceptance_criteria: Users with completed bookings can create posts with title, body, tags, and optional image URL
Post authors can edit their own posts within any timeframe (no 24h restriction implemented yet - add comment for future enhancement)
Post authors can delete their own posts (soft delete sets hidden=true)
Edit and delete buttons only appear for post authors
Community feed has working tag filter dropdown and text search
All community text uses translate pipe with COMMUNITY.* keys
mr.json file exists with same structure as en.json
Backend prevents non-authors from editing or deleting posts (403 response)
verifiedGuard protects post creation and editing
verification: cd /Users/kedarpatil/Documents/kedar/tedbus_project/REDBUS-CLONE-MEAN-main-3/.worktrees/tedbus-complete-upgrade/frontend && npm run build -- produces no TypeScript errors
Start backend and frontend, sign in with Google, navigate to /community, verify post creation form appears and submits successfully
Create a post as user A, verify edit and delete buttons appear. Sign in as user B, verify edit and delete buttons do NOT appear on user A's post
Test tag filter and search - verify posts filter correctly in the UI
Verify all community UI text is translated when language is switched to Hindi
findings:
Successfully implemented complete community platform with:
- Backend: Added updatePost and deletePost controller methods with author-only authorization checking X-User-Id header. Added PUT and DELETE routes with verifiedGuard on PUT. Added imageUrl field to Post model.
- Frontend: Added updatePost and deletePost methods to CommunityService. Updated post-card component with inline edit form and edit/delete buttons that only show for post authors. Added image display for posts with imageUrl. Updated community-feed with imageUrl input, tag filter dropdown, and text search input that filters locally on title and body. All new UI uses translate pipe with COMMUNITY.* keys.
- Translations: Added COMMUNITY.POST_IMAGE, EDIT_POST, DELETE_POST, DELETE_CONFIRM, FILTER_BY_TAG, SEARCH_POSTS to en.json and hi.json. Created mr.json (Marathi) with same structure as en.json using placeholder English text.
- Build: Verified with npm run build - no TypeScript errors, only warnings about optional chaining and bundle size.
- Authorization: Backend checks that req.headers['x-user-id'] matches post.authorId before allowing edit/delete (returns 403 if mismatch). Frontend shows edit/delete buttons only when authService.currentUser.id === post.authorId.
